title: Let's Make a Deal
description:
S2026
CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
description:
E1
Matthew Cox is a former mortgage broker from Florida who found himself on the Secret Service's most wanted list; he made millions falsifying homeownership and mortgage documents for five times the properties' actual worth.

title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
description:

title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
description:

description:
E5

title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai

title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
description:
E2
The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish.

title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
description:

title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
description:

After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts.

title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
description:
E5

title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
description:
E6
Casey and his crew wander the tidal flats and interior of Katmai and find the bones of a humpback whale that washed ashore.

description:

title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers of Nepal
description:
